rows.traditional: A 同 B 都 V 對方
rows.jyutping: A tung4 B dou1 V deoi3 fong1
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when both sides reciprocally feel or do something to each other.

example.english: We have mutual respect for each other.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 dou1 zyun1 zung6 deoi3 fong1

rows.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 dou1 sik1 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this for a person or thing that the relevant people all know or share, especially a mutual friend.

example.english: This is a mutual friend we all know.
example.traditional: 呢個係大家都識嘅朋友。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 sik1 ge3 pang4 jau5

rows.traditional: A 同 B 係對方嘅 N
rows.jyutping: A tung4 B hai6 deoi3 fong1 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this when A and B have the same relationship to each other, such as being each other’s enemies.

example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hai6 deoi3 fong1 ge3 sei2 deoi3 tau4
